text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning many races together 
with Matikanefukukitaru—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaan! Good news, glorious news, 
coo-coo-coo~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The time has finally come! Look here, 
check out this fortune I just drew fresh 
from the box!"

I received a brand-new fortune slip from 
Matikane Fukukitaru and read what was 
written.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? That hot springs trip we 
won from the raffle back then, only to 
have the heavens make us wait a whole year 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It had been about a year, so when I drew 
another fortune, this is what was written 
under the 'Travel' section.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it about time to let it slide?" 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why is it in such casual slang~~~?!

Even if asked, I wouldn't know. Yet, it 
seems God has finally granted his 
permission.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, no time like the present! I 
actually made up my mind quite a while 
ago, but today is the luckiest of lucky 
days!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Twinkle Series has settled 
down, let's head out on our 'Lucky Hot 
Springs Trip☆'! Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Stuff my backpack with rice crackers~, and 
with a leisurely pass, off we go~♪

And so, carrying a massive supply of tea 
snacks, we headed off on our hot springs 
trip.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hohe~, that bath felt so nice~. This truly 
is pure paradise~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
They even have an auspicious golden bath! 
Truly a blessing, what divine favor~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Were you able to have a nice, relaxing 
rest too, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hyohoho, your face looks completely 
relaxed~. Well then, well then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn up the hype from here on! The 
Happy Grand Banquet is officially 
underway~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! We didn't come here today for a 
relaxing "Ah, that was a nice hot bath, 
wasn't it, dear~" hot spring cure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A wild celebration for finishing the run! 
Cut loose, and let's party like there's no 
tomorrow, happy days!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I came to this land because I wanted to 
hold a massive banquet so hype even the 
gods would party!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san! Tonight, let's 
party, drink tea, and sing with everything 
we've got!

Such an abnormal level of enthusiasm... To 
think she wanted to hold a banquet this 
badly.

The festival-loving "Celebratory Shrine 
Maiden." Perhaps that too is simply one 
facet of Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Miss, bring a sashimi boat to our room! 
And bring all the special dishes listed on 
the menu in one giant rush!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
While you're eating and drinking, Trainer, 
I'm gonna perform a quick trick for you!

And so, alongside a lavish feast, 
Machikane Fukukitaru's party trick contest 
began.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Quick gag, number 1! An Umamusume who's 
cheerful even though she's about to lose!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "IMPOSSIBLLLLLE!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Quick gag, number 2! Suzuka-san, staying 
completely deadpan even after becoming a 
god!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I hope your wish comes true. ...Well, see 
you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Quick gag, number 3! Umamusume animal 
fortune-telling!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Wait, I'm a horse type?!"

From genuinely funny things to things that 
make no sense, Matikanefukukitaru fires 
them off one after another. And then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh~. Quick gag number 64... Lord 
Bishamonten, soaking wet...
choice_data_list: Why don't you eat some food soon?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, indeed~. It was so much fun, I just 
got carried away~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Before eating, though... let me... rest a 
bit..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

Having made such a fuss without rest, she 
must have been exhausted, as she began 
nodding off to sleep.

As I wonder where to lay her down to 
rest... a slip of paper tumbles out from 
her hand.

—It was a joke notebook. All the material 
for the gag earlier was written inside.

"Written and rewritten over and over in 
messy handwriting. Countless ideas for 
party tricks..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san... There's more... more fun 
stuff to come, you know...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle... thank you for all your hard 
work... Thanks for taking me this far... 
zzz...

I assumed she was just making a racket 
because she's a 'Festive Shrine Maiden.'

Apparently, that wasn't the case. It was 
intended as a gesture of gratitude for 
everything so far...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz... pshuuuuu...

Gently laying down the greatest goddess of 
fortune, I spread a blanket over her.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with 
Matikanefukukitaru...
